scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl lg:text-[6vw] tracking-tighter leading-none

rules: Avoid Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk completely.
Use Cormorant Garamond for main display headings, giving it a high-end editorial feel.
Counters, pagination ('01 — 05') should use mono or minimal sans with wide tracking.
Do not use generic bold everywhere; utilize font-light or font-medium for elegance.
Red (#E10600) is ONLY for accents: active dots, thin thread lines, primary CTA buttons, hover states. NEVER use large red blocks or full backgrounds.
Borders and dividers should be ultra-thin: border-black/10 or border-[#E10600]/30.
Avoid any gradients unless it's a subtle black scrim for hero text legibility (max bg-black/40).

visual_enhancers.borders: Square corners (rounded-none) for all images and cards to mimic printed editorial photos. Buttons can be slightly rounded (rounded-sm) or pill-shaped for contrast.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to none. Use 1px borders (border-black/5) to define edges rather than soft shadows.
visual_enhancers.photography: Spotlight effect, high contrast. Use grayscale filters on hover out, or color on hover in.
visual_enhancers.dividers: Use thin red lines (1px h-full or w-full bg-[#E10600]) for structural dividers and reading flow.

signature_animations: Masked line-by-line headline reveal: wrap text lines in overflow-hidden, translate Y from 100% to 0.
Subtle Parallax: Hero images scale from 1.1 to 1.0 on load, and translate Y slightly on scroll.
Red Thread: A vertical 1px red line that grows on scroll or acts as a progress bar for the hero carousel.
Hover: Images scale up slightly inside a clipped frame (overflow-hidden).

navigation.style: Sticky minimal nav. Backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80. Border-b border-black/5.
navigation.layout: Logo left (Cormorant Garamond), Links right (Outfit, uppercase, text-xs, tracking-widest). Mobile: hamburger menu.
navigation.interaction: Links have a red underline that scales X on hover (origin-left).

hero_carousel.features: Autoplay, swipe/drag, pause on hover. Vertical red thread progress line on the left/right edge. Slide counter '01 — 05'.

pricing_cards.layout: Horizontal scrollable flex/grid container with snap-x snap-mandatory.
pricing_cards.style: Border border-black/10. Center-focused active card scales up (scale-105) and gets a subtle shadow. Others scale-95 opacity-70.

portfolio_tiles.layout: 4 large tiles, grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 or 4 vertical columns on hover.
portfolio_tiles.style: Cover photo, specialty tag. Click expands to masonry gallery with lightbox.

buttons.primary: bg-[#E10600] text-white px-8 py-4 text-sm tracking-widest uppercase hover:bg-black transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#111111] border border-black/20 px-8 py-4 text-sm tracking-widest uppercase hover:border-[#E10600] hover:text-[#E10600]

home: Brief intro with line-by-line reveal animation
about: Numbered manifesto chapters (01. Authenticity, 02. Emotion, 03. Detail)
B&W Founder portrait with short story
testimonials: Alternating layout (Image left, text right; then reversed)
contact: Massive 'Ready to tell your story?' text

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: No generic centered layouts. Use grid logic with heavy asymmetry.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on headers over images; use a backdrop-blur.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main layout.
Do not use generic 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties.
Avoid AI emoji icons in the UI. Use Lucide or Phosphor if needed, but stick to text and thin lines where possible.
Create depth through layering, but keep edges sharp (no soft drop shadows unless specifically needed for the pricing center card).
